notes: Wireless conferencing/collaboration base unit (desktop, not rack-mountable; dimensions 34 x 135 x 135 mm). Rear panel: Power connection, HDMI out, LAN Ethernet, Kensington lock (physical anti-theft slot, not a signal port, omitted). Front panel: 1x USB-C and 1x USB-A, both USB 3.0 on this 2nd-generation unit (1st-gen used USB 2.0). USB-C on the front is a bidirectional/data port used for button pairing and firmware/USB-stick access, and can alternatively supply DC power to the unit (external barrel-connector power adapter has priority when both are connected) — modeled here as a single bidirectional USB-C port; its optional power-delivery role is not broken out separately. Video output is HDMI 1.4b (4K UHD 3840x2160 @30Hz) or, alternatively, DisplayPort 1.2 signal carried over the same front USB-C port — not modeled as a second video output since it is the same physical connector as the data port. Power adapter is external, 12V DC / 2A / 24W max output via barrel connector into the unit's "Power connection" input (input side is standard IEC-style AC brick, not on the unit itself). Ethernet is 1 Gbit (RJ45).
